name: Carousel
description:
The Carousel component is a versatile UI element that allows users to navigate through a slideshow style set of "pages" which contain images.

The Carousel component can be used in various contexts, mostly pertaining to marketing sites. It is uncommon for application development but is not restricted to for a UX pattern.

props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the element.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the carousel. Useful for composition.

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.

props.name: slidesPerPage
props.description: The number of slides to show at a time.

props.name: autoSize
props.description: Whether to enable variable width slides.

props.name: slidesPerMove
props.description: The number of slides to scroll at a time. When set to `auto`, the number of slides to scroll is determined by the `slidesPerPage` property.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Whether to scroll automatically. The default delay is 4000ms.

props.name: allowMouseDrag
props.description: Whether to allow scrolling via dragging with mouse

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the carousel should loop around.

props.name: page
props.description: The controlled page of the carousel.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: The initial page to scroll to when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the page of the carousel.

props.name: spacing
props.description: The amount of space between items.

props.name: padding
props.description: Defines the extra space added around the scrollable area, enabling nearby items to remain partially in view.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Function called when the page changes.

props.name: inViewThreshold
props.description: The threshold for determining if an item is in view.

props.name: snapType
props.description: The snap type of the item.

props.name: slideCount
props.description: The total number of slides. Useful for SSR to render the initial ating the snap points.

props.name: onDragStatusChange
props.description: Function called when the drag status changes.

props.name: onAutoplayStatusChange
props.description: Function called when the autoplay status changes.
